app_fee.value: Central research admissions guidance does not state an application fee for postgraduate research degrees; taught master's application fees do not apply to PGR.

fee_waiver.value: Central research admissions guidance does not publish fee waivers as no general PGR application fee is stated.

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for postgraduate research admission at Manchester.

toefl_min.value: For most standard PhD/MPhil programmes, minimum TOEFL iBT requirement is 90 with at least 22 in each component.
toefl_min.quote:
a minimum IELTS score of 6.5 overall or TOEFL (iBT) 90;
each component of the English test to meet the minimum requirement of IELTS 5.5 in all components, TOEFL (iBT 22);

ielts_min.value: For most standard PhD/MPhil programmes, minimum IELTS Academic requirement is 6.5 overall (minimum 5.5 in all components and 6.0 in writing).

english_waiver.value: Exemption applies only to nationals of UKVI-prescribed majority English-speaking countries or those holding degrees from those countries; degrees from India do not qualify.
english_waiver.quote: For Student Route visa purposes, the UKVI has a prescribed list of Majority English-speaking countries (this list is not defined by The University of Manchester).

notes: Postgraduate research degrees at Manchester include PhD and MPhil programmes across the Faculty of Science and Engineering and the Faculty of Biology, Medicine and Health.
